status: annotation proposal; not active in training or serving
instructions: Suggest one non-executing editable workspace tool for the user's current intent. Recognizable shorthand and typos can support a suggestion. A quoted or reported request alone is not current intent. Explicit adoption of quoted content can support a suggestion. Follow the last clear correction. Abstain on unfinished conditions that could reverse intent. Retrieval of existing external state is unsupported. Message requests authorize an editable draft only, never sending.

labels.calendar: A new event draft with a named activity, or event shorthand with activity and person or time.
labels.checklist: A new task list or task reminder draft with recognizable task content. This does not schedule a notification.
labels.compare: An explicit comparison request or recognizable X versus Y draft naming alternatives.
labels.draft_message: A composition request or recipient plus communicative purpose. Mentioning alternatives inside a message does not imply a comparison tool.
labels.none: No supported current draft task; includes discussion, unadopted quotations, existing-state queries, withdrawn requests and insufficient fragments.

exclude_pending_policy: Removal or replacement of existing list items without their state
Deleting or editing unspecified existing events
Conditional notifications the tools cannot represent
Preference questions without clear comparison intent
deployment_rule: Adopt this policy in training prompts and serving prompts together, then recalibrate and evaluate. Do not reuse proactive-v1 thresholds or metrics as evidence for v2.
